snippet.title: S U R V I V E THE A.I. : The First Card Game That Can Talk
snippet.description: The First-ever talking card game! Your cards act as real-time tactical advisors. Command Humans, AI, or Hybrids, contend for 3 scarce resources—Energy, Compute, and Creativity—to unleash your cards' Awaken skill. Experience deep AI dialogue and strategy, and master your tomorrow on the board!
